flows.name: 删除指标：草稿 → 追加实时功率 → 删实时功率+加冰箱功率 → 接受 → 核对 → 刷新恢复

steps.text: 生成 A 机房昨日能耗日报，包含总耗电、设备排名和趋势分析

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.plan-action-select'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; s.value = 'confirm'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled); for (let i = sels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const s = sels[i]; const o = Array.from(s.options).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '同意'); if (o) { s.value = o.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; } } return false; })()
document.getElementById('preview-root').innerText.includes('总耗电')

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')); const hit = cards.find(c => c.querySelector('[data-region-metric]')); return hit ? hit.querySelector('h3.region-name').innerText.trim() : ''; })()

(() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled && !s.closest('[data-pending-plan]')); for (let i = sels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const s = sels[i]; const o = Array.from(s.options).find(x => /^(修改|继续修改|继续调整)$/.test(x.textContent.trim())); if (o) { s.value = o.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; } } return false; })()

(() => { const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-other-input')); const enabled = all.filter(i => !i.disabled); const visible = enabled.filter(i => i.offsetParent !== null); return enabled.length === 1 && visible.length === 1; })()
(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan]'); if (!c) return false; const t = c.innerText; return t.includes('追加') && t.includes('实时功率'); })()

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-pending-plan]')); const c = cards[cards.length - 1]; if (!c) return false; const s = c.querySelector('.question-select'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const o = Array.from(s.options).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!o) return false; s.value = o.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
document.getElementById('preview-root').innerText.includes('实时功率')

(() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled && !s.closest('[data-pending-plan]')); for (let i = sels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const s = sels[i]; const o = Array.from(s.options).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '其他'); if (o) { s.value = o.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; } } return false; })()

(() => { const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-other-input')); const enabled = all.filter(i => !i.disabled); const visible = enabled.filter(i => i.offsetParent !== null); return enabled.length === 1 && visible.length === 1; })()

steps.text: {{cardName}}删除实时功率这个指标 再增加一个冰箱功率的指标

steps.eval: (() => { return document.querySelectorAll('[data-pending-plan]').length >= 2 ? 'two' : ''; })()

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-pending-plan]')); const c = cards[cards.length - 1]; if (!c) return false; const t = c.innerText; return t.includes('删除指标') && t.includes('实时功率') && t.includes('追加指标') && t.includes('冰箱功率'); })()
(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-pending-plan]')); const c = cards[cards.length - 1]; if (!c) return false; return !c.innerText.includes('删除卡片'); })()

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-pending-plan]')); const c = cards[cards.length - 1]; if (!c) return false; const s = c.querySelector('.question-select'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const o = Array.from(s.options).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!o) return false; s.value = o.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
